infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: FlowGuard uses your location to pin an issue report or centre the water map on your area. You can always type your area instead.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: FlowGuard uses your camera to attach photo evidence to an issue report.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: FlowGuard needs access to attach a photo to an issue report.
